test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

He was __acquitted__ of all the charges in the court today.
solution: The correct answer is '**Convicted**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the underlined word '**Acquitted**' is '**Convicted**' • **Acquitted**: to state formally that a person is not guilty of a crime. (किसी के निर्दोष होने की विधिवत घोषणा करना) • *Example: The jury **acquitted** her of murder.* • **Convicted**: to say officially in a court of law that somebody is guilty of a crime. (न्‍यायालय द्वारा अपराधी या दोषी ठहराया जाना) • *Example: He was **convicted** of armed robbery and sent to prison.* **Correct Answer:__** *Convicted.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Conformed**: to obey a rule or law. (नियम या क़ानून का अनुपालन करना; के अनुसार होना; संगत होना) • **Discharged**: to send something out (a liquid, gas, etc.) [(द्रव, गैस आदि को) छोड़ना] • **Praised**: to say that somebody/something is good and should be admired. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की प्रशंसा करना, उसे सराहना) 39:Tb17, The correct answer is '**conceited**'.
